description: the v1 store: knobs set on fit runs 0 to 23, held-out runs 24 to 29 scored
notice: Synthetic data: laboratory weeks designed by language models and simulated by this project's code, with no clinical review. Every timing parameter is an assumption.

settings.headline: 6/shift
settings.knob: bisection, 30 steps, on each tuning group's history from alert volume alone

quantile_local.fitted_on: collection-to-receipt times of fit runs 0 to 23

quantile_global.fitted_on: collection-to-receipt times of fit runs 0 to 23

tracernet.fitted_on: train (TracerNet artifact), recalibrated on each tuning group's history

local_fit.note: on legacy_v1 the history is fit runs 0 to 23 for every method, so the local and global refits are the same committed fit

matched_volume.note: knobs re-solved on the scored replicates from alert volume alone, per tuning group: a sensitivity check (R4), never a replacement
matched_volume.trigger: R4 failed: unequal realized alert volume

R1.rule: **R1. Warning.** Its median warning over all breaches, a miss counting as zero, exceeds that of the window-aware rule, of the analytic model refit globally and of the analytic model refit locally by at least 5 minutes each, with the lower end of the 95% paired cluster-bootstrap interval of every difference above zero, at both the default 3-2-1 and the equal urgency weights.

R2.rule: **R2. Losses.** Its share of never-received specimens alerted before the window closes is not lower than any of those baselines' by more than 2 percentage points (upper end of the 95% interval of the deficit below 2 points).

R3.rule: **R3. Calibration.** Its Brier score at 30 and at 60 minutes of silence is no worse than the better analytic refit's by more than 0.01 (the rule of `docs/architecture.md` §5.2.1).

R4.rule: **R4. Equal alerts.** Its realized alerts per shift on the scored replicates are within 10% of each baseline's. If not, the comparison is reported as unequal, and R1 is repeated at matched realized volume (knobs re-solved on the scored replicates from alert volume alone, for every method) as a sensitivity check, not a replacement.

verdict.text: If R1 to R3 hold, TracerNet becomes the primary risk model. Otherwise the analytic model stays primary and TracerNet is reported as a challenger result.
